name: many_voices
for: Mother of the Black Water: many voices
notes: Her waking: her voice with every voice at once: six drowned faces (three fainter ones a step behind for depth), two echoes, a more agitated front, more wisps and drips. Same band. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 86; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 58; place that point on the ring's position.
